title: AMPscript test data
description: Test data for AMPscript Preview & Check and the ampscript CLI.

subscribers.description: Test subscribers. The preview can switch between them, and checks run against every one.

items.description: Profile attributes, e.g. FirstName, EmailAddress, SubscriberKey. Add _label to name the subscriber in the preview.

_label.description: Name shown in the preview's subscriber list.

subscriber.description: A single test subscriber. Use subscribers for more than one.

dataExtensions.description: Data extensions by name, each a list of rows. Or a folder of CSV files (one file per data extension).

contentBlocks.description: Content blocks by key or name for ContentBlockByKey/Name/Id. Or a folder of files.

requestParameters.description: Query string and form values for RequestParameter() on CloudPages.

now.description: What Now() returns, e.g. 2026-12-24T09:00:00. Use it to test date logic.
